{{Quote|They're all worth more than your craven hide, so you miss even ONE, consider yourself an enemy of the Nova Blades!|Yarvok compares the worth of his pets to Krupo|<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Invasive Species on Dantooine}}</ref>}}
'''Krupo''' was a beast wrangler who worked for [[Yarvok]],<ref name="Codex" /> a [[Nova Blades]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]].<ref name="Marauders">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=event|The Marauders of Dantooine}}</ref> By [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Pet">{{TOR updates|6.3}}. The relevant Codex entry was released with this update.</ref> a ship carrying Krupo and many of Yarvok's pets crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Though an individual named [[Jayse]] advised Yarvok to be glad to everyone made it out alive, Yarvok was furious that his prized pets, [[Rox (Skar'kla)|Rox]], [[Yug]], [[Wa-Vendeg]], [[Flappy]], [[Fuzzy (Xuvva)|Fuzzy]], [[Spike (pet)|Spike]], and [[Ol' Cronchy]] were missing. Yarvok told Krupo that he was a "[[List of phrases and slang/Legends#S|son of a murglak]]" and threatened to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Krupo if his missing pets were not found and returned quickly because Yarvok believed his pets were frightened and alone without their "papa."<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Krupo was mentioned in the Codex entry for Invasive Species on Dantooine in the [[2019]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]].<ref name="Codex" />
